title: Measures to Enhance Anti-money Laundering Compliance
what_it_is: Measures to Enhance Anti-money Laundering Compliance

sections.label: Financial centre abuse risk
sections.summary: As Singapore's financial centre grows, vigilance is needed against its abuse for illicit financing activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: As Singapore's financial centre grows in scale and sophistication, we have to be vigilant against the risk of its abuse for illicit financing activities.

sections.label: Anti-money laundering regime elements
sections.summary: Singapore's anti-money laundering regime comprises strict regulations, rigorous supervision, effective enforcement and good cross-border cooperation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Our regime against money laundering comprises four key elements: strict regulations, rigorous supervision, effective enforcement and good cross-border cooperation.

sections.label: Measures strengthening anti-money laundering regime
sections.summary: Recent measures include criminalising laundering of serious tax offences, enhancing MAS' Notices and Guidelines, and stepping up inspections of financial institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: More recent measures taken to strengthen our regime include criminalising the laundering of serious tax offences; enhancing MAS' Notices and Guidelines in line with evolving international standards; and stepping up our inspections of financial institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS will not hesitate to take firm actions against financial institutions whose anti-money laundering controls are found to be lacking.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: As Mr Ong has highlighted, MAS decided to withdraw the merchant bank status of BSI Bank for recurrent and serious breaches of anti-money laundering control requirements and MAS has also referred six members of the bank's senior management and staff to the Public Prosecutor.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: We are also making organisational changes so as to enhance MAS' supervisory focus and effectiveness at a time of increasing sophistication of illegal money flows globally.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: So, MAS will consolidate supervisory responsibilities relating to money laundering and other illicit financing risks in a dedicated department.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS will also have a new enforcement department that will work closely with the Commercial Affairs Department (CAD) to investigate money laundering and other financial market offences.

sections.label: New international standards compliance cost
sections.summary: New international standards are being complied with by all financial institutions, increasing compliance cost across the board.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: These are new international standards that all financial institutions are complying with.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, it does increase compliance cost but it is being done across the board and is applied on all financial institutions, be it in Singapore or internationally.
